question: Compare VAT revenue in Table 7.1 with education spending in Table 7.2 for 2018. Give both trillion-dong amounts and their difference, without claiming the VAT was earmarked for education.
answer:
In 2018, VAT revenue in Table 7.1 is 344 trillion dong. [p199-table-7.1]

In 2018, education spending in Table 7.2 is 220 trillion dong. [p200-table-7.2]

The difference between VAT revenue (344 trillion dong) and education spending (220 trillion dong) is 124 trillion dong. [p199-table-7.1] [p200-table-7.2]
